title: Hot Stamping Pressure Guide for Paper Packaging

seo.title: Hot Stamping Pressure Guide for Paper Packaging

content:
In hot stamping, machine force affects transfer quality, edge clarity and paper surface appearance.

## Main Point

If the setting is too low, foil may transfer incompletely. If it is too high, small lines may look thick and the paper surface may show marks.

## How to Adjust

Change one setting at a time. Compare small text, a logo and a solid area. If one side looks better than the other, check machine balance and setup.

## FAQ

### Is more force always better?

No. Too much can reduce edge clarity.

### What should I test?

Check transfer completeness, edge clarity and surface marks.

## Sample Support

Send a stamped sample photo and paper type. We can help review the likely cause.
